config.title: Errors
config.description: Critical and error logs, plus logs with no severity that mention error, exception, fatal or panic

dataSourceConfig.query: * | format if ("severity_text":*) "<lc:severity_text>" as _sq_sev | format if (-_sq_sev:* "level":*) "<lc:level>" as _sq_sev | format if (-_sq_sev:* "severity":*) "<lc:severity>" as _sq_sev | format if (-_sq_sev:* "log.level":*) "<lc:log.level>" as _sq_sev | format if (-_sq_sev:* "detected_level":*) "<lc:detected_level>" as _sq_sev | format if (-_sq_sev:* "loglevel":*) "<lc:loglevel>" as _sq_sev | replace_regexp ("^(fatal|panic|emerg|emergency|alert|crit|critical).*$", "critical") at _sq_sev | replace_regexp ("^(err|error|severe).*$", "error") at _sq_sev | replace_regexp ("^warn.*$", "warning") at _sq_sev | replace_regexp ("^(info|information|informational|notice)$", "info") at _sq_sev | replace_regexp ("^(debug|trace|verbose).*$", "debug") at _sq_sev | replace_regexp ("^(unspecified|unset|none|unknown|-)$", "") at _sq_sev | format if (-_sq_sev:* severity_number:range[21, 24]) "critical" as _sq_sev | format if (-_sq_sev:* severity_number:range[17, 20]) "error" as _sq_sev | format if (-_sq_sev:* severity_number:range[13, 16]) "warning" as _sq_sev | format if (-_sq_sev:* severity_number:range[9, 12]) "info" as _sq_sev | format if (-_sq_sev:* severity_number:range[1, 8]) "debug" as _sq_sev | format if (-_sq_sev:* _msg:~"(^|[^[:alnum:]_])(FATAL|PANIC|CRITICAL|CRIT)([^[:alnum:]_]|$)|(?i:(^|[^[:alnum:]_])(level|lvl)=(fatal|panic|crit|critical)([^[:alnum:]_]|$)|^[^[:space:]]+[[:space:]]+(fatal|panic|crit|critical)[[:space:]]|^[[:space:]]*(crit):)") "critical" as _sq_sev | format if (-_sq_sev:* _msg:~"(^|[^[:alnum:]_])(ERROR|ERR)([^[:alnum:]_]|$)|(?i:(^|[^[:alnum:]_])(level|lvl)=(error|err|eror)([^[:alnum:]_]|$)|^[^[:space:]]+[[:space:]]+(error|err)[[:space:]]|^[[:space:]]*(fail|error):)") "error" as _sq_sev | format if (-_sq_sev:* _msg:~"(^|[^[:alnum:]_])WARN(ING)?([^[:alnum:]_]|$)|(?i:(^|[^[:alnum:]_])(level|lvl)=warn(ing)?([^[:alnum:]_]|$)|^[^[:space:]]+[[:space:]]+warn(ing)?[[:space:]]|^[[:space:]]*(warn):)") "warning" as _sq_sev | format if (-_sq_sev:* _msg:~"(^|[^[:alnum:]_])INFO([^[:alnum:]_]|$)|(?i:(^|[^[:alnum:]_])(level|lvl)=info([^[:alnum:]_]|$)|^[^[:space:]]+[[:space:]]+info[[:space:]]|^[[:space:]]*(info):)") "info" as _sq_sev | format if (-_sq_sev:* _msg:~"(^|[^[:alnum:]_])(DEBUG|TRACE)([^[:alnum:]_]|$)|(?i:(^|[^[:alnum:]_])(level|lvl)=(debug|dbug|trace)([^[:alnum:]_]|$)|^[^[:space:]]+[[:space:]]+(debug|trace)[[:space:]]|^[[:space:]]*(dbug|trce):)") "debug" as _sq_sev | format if (-_sq_sev:* _msg:~"(?i:(^|[^[:alnum:]_])(error|exception|fatal|panic)([^[:alnum:]_]|$))") "error" as _sq_sev | format if (-_sq_sev:*) "unknown" as _sq_sev | rename _sq_sev as severity | stats count() if (severity:in(critical, error)) errors
